title: AG60122: Advanced Dairy Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Operation Flood and Dairy Development programmes in India, Physico-chemical
properties and structure of milk and milk constituents, Chemical and microbial
spoilage of milk and milk product, common dairy processes- cream separation
(standardization), pasteurization, sterilization and homogenisation. Market
milk, special milks, manufacture of milk products- butter, cream, cheese, icecream, evaporated milk, condensed milk, dried milk, butter oil, dried milk
products, Indian dairy industry. Methods and procedures for sampling and
testing of milk and milk products. Laws and standards for milk and milk
products.
